The '''1998–99 Egyptian Premier League''' was contested by 14 teams. The first team in the league, [[Al Ahly SC|Al Ahly]] was the champion and qualified for the [[2000 CAF Champions League]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Stokkermans |first=Karel |date=2009-07-09 |title=African Club Competitions 2000 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/afcup00.html |access-date=2026-08-06 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref> Second placed team [[Zamalek SC|Zamalek]] qualified for the [[2000 African Cup Winners' Cup]] via winning the [[1998–99 Egypt Cup|Egypt Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hassanin |first=Amro |last2=King |first2=Ian |last3=Qayed |first3=Mohammed |date=1999-09-27 |title=Egypt 1998/99 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/egy99.html |access-date=2026-08-06 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref> Third placed team [[Ismaily SC|Ismaily]] qualified for the [[2000 CAF Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Egypt - Egyptian Premier League 1998/1999 - Standings, Fixtures & Stats - Soccer |url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/competition/egyptian-premier-league-1998-1999/31955 |access-date=2026-08-06 |website=Global Sports Archive |language=en}}</ref>
